prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Tyler. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean Tyler, Texas? And do you want a UV tanning bed or a spray/sunless tan? Also: any budget limits or timing (an event soon)? That will change which salons I recommend.

If you want quick next steps, I can look up current, highly rated salons in Tyler and give names, addresses, phone numbers and which ones to call first. Want me to do that?

If you’d rather decide now, call one of each of these types and pick based on answers they give:

- Dedicated spray-tan studio (why call): typically the safest option for a first timer. Ask whether they use a branded system (Mystic, Versa, SunFX), whether technicians are certified, if they do a patch test and custom color matching, and what the aftercare is.
- Full-service tanning salon that offers beds + spray (why call): you can compare both methods and get a staff skin assessment. Ask about age of beds/bulbs, bed type (high-pressure vs low-pressure), first-time specials, and how they handle people with fair/med/dark skin.
- National chain or gym with tanning (why call): often cheaper or has membership deals—good if you plan repeat visits. Ask about cleanliness, bulb replacement frequency, and if they require goggles or provide towels.

What to ask every salon when you call:
- Do you have any first-time specials or packages?
- Do you offer a skin assessment and recommended session length?
- For spray: which brand/system, is it technician-applied or automated, do you do a patch test?
- For UV beds: what brand/age are the beds and how often are bulbs changed?
- Do you provide/provide goggles and towels? Is there a private shower?
- Any pregnancy or medication contraindications I should know about?
- Cancellation policy and how to prepare (exfoliation, no deodorant, etc.)

Tell me whether you mean Tyler, TX and which tanning method you prefer, and I’ll pull up specific salons to call (names, addresses, phone numbers, and the best one or two to call first).
